faq.q: How long does a money date take?
faq.a: Twenty minutes. The agenda gives each part a time: two, five, two, five, three and two minutes.
Couples who share some or all of their money and want a regular, calm way to talk about it.

faq.q: Can I use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes. It is a PDF, so any PDF app works. You can also print it on US Letter or on A4 at fit to page.
No. The record boxes are on paper. The Couples Money Reset adds a Google Sheet and more if you want it.

faq.q: What if the conversation gets tense?
faq.a: The page has a line for exactly that: a way to pause and return when you are both calmer.
No. It is a meeting format. General education, not financial advice.
